class.name: NNDebugger
class.brief_description: Runtime singleton for inspecting, recording, pausing, and stepping Noodle Nodes AI roots.
class.description: Engine singleton that tracks live Noodle Nodes roots in the scene tree, exposes snapshots and event logs for debugging tools, and lets you pause or single-step AI ticks. Only registered in debug builds of a running game (not in the editor or release builds). Always check [code]Engine.has_singleton("NNDebugger")[/code] and access it untyped via [code]Engine.get_singleton("NNDebugger")[/code]. Most users only need the built-in editor debugger dock; use this API when building custom in-game overlays or test tools.

constants.constant: Pausing stops only scheduled Noodle Nodes AI ticks while the rest of the game keeps running.
Pausing stops both scheduled Noodle Nodes AI ticks and the [SceneTree].

method.name: diff_snapshots
method.description: Returns a delta dictionary describing the changes from [param previous] to [param current], without modifying either input.

method.name: get_event_capacity
method.description: Returns the maximum number of events kept per watched root.

method.name: get_events
method.description: Returns recorded events for [param root_id] with a sequence number greater than [param after_seq], oldest first. Events are only recorded while the root is watched via [method watch].

method.name: get_node_properties
method.description: Returns a sanitized dictionary of inspector-visible and script properties for the live object with [param node_id], or an empty dictionary if it no longer exists.

method.name: get_pause_scope
method.description: Returns the active [enum PauseScope]. Defaults to [constant PAUSE_SCOPE_AI].

method.name: get_root_info
method.description: Returns metadata for a single registered root, or an empty dictionary if it no longer exists.

method.name: get_roots
method.description: Returns metadata dictionaries for all live registered Noodle Nodes roots in registration order.

method.name: get_snapshot
method.description: Returns the current debugger snapshot for [param root_id], or an empty dictionary if it no longer exists.

method.name: is_paused
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the debugger is paused.

method.name: is_watched
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while [param root_id] has at least one active watcher.

method.name: set_event_capacity
method.description: Sets the maximum number of events retained per root (minimum [code]1[/code]). Oldest events are dropped when full.

method.name: set_pause_scope
method.description: Sets whether pausing stops only AI ticks ([constant PAUSE_SCOPE_AI]) or also pauses the [SceneTree] ([constant PAUSE_SCOPE_GAME]). Emits [signal pause_scope_changed].

method.name: set_paused
method.description: Pauses or resumes scheduled AI root ticks (and the [SceneTree] when [constant PAUSE_SCOPE_GAME] is active). Manual [code]tick()[/code] calls are unaffected. Emits [signal paused_changed].

method.name: step
method.description: While paused, advances every scheduled AI root by one frame and then pauses again. With [constant PAUSE_SCOPE_GAME], also runs one game frame.

method.name: unwatch
method.description: Removes a watcher from [param root_id]. Stops event recording and clears stored events when the last watcher leaves.

method.name: watch
method.description: Adds a watcher to [param root_id] and begins recording its events. Match each call with [method unwatch].

signal.name: pause_scope_changed
signal.description: Emitted after [method set_pause_scope] changes the scope.

signal.name: paused_changed
signal.description: Emitted after [method set_paused] changes the pause state.

signal.name: root_added
signal.description: Emitted when a root enters the tree and becomes registered. [param info] has the keys documented in [method get_roots].

signal.name: root_removed
signal.description: Emitted when a registered root leaves the tree or is freed.
